![](images/swapnil_jm_picture.jpg){.headshot fig-alt="Photograph of Swapnil Motghare"}

I am an Applied Microeconomist with research interests in Labor Economics. I currently work as [Researcher in the California Policy Lab](https://capolicylab.org/staff/swapnil-motghare/) at the University of California Los Angeles where I am part of a team focused on labor and employment. Before joining CPL, I worked as Assistant Research Professor and Postdoctoral Research Associate at the University of Notre Dame.

I earned a PhD in Economics from the University of Arizona, an MA in Economics from the University of Texas at Austin, a Postgraduate Diploma in Management from Indian Institute of Management Shillong, and a Bachelor of Technology in Mechanical Engineering from Mumbai University, India.

You can download my CV from this link: [CV](files/CV.pdf)
